Name: Wizard-Girl Sprite Replacement
Author: lolicage
Description:
A sprite i threw together to go with the wizard girl portrait mod which you can download somewhere else.

It turns the creepy old man who lives in the tower into a cute wizard girl!

tried to keep it close to the same dimensions as the other girls in town, while taking the liberty of editing some of what i feel is "awkward chucklefish style" pixel art.

if you intend to match the sprite to the portrait mod, be warned i don't have a glasses version, that will be included depending on demand.

installation instructions :  throw the wizard.xnb file into the [stardew > Characters] folder and replace. make backups beforehand.
uninstallation : put your backup wizard.xnb into the Characters folder and re-replace.

note:
the game automatically adds breathing effects, but it doesn't automatically make the characters blink (like the player character does). dunno what i can do for this.

future versions : alternate sprites / maybe glasses, maybe recolor, maybe shorter.

the wizard girl portraits can be found included in [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mod-make-wizard-a-cute-girl-and-cute-boy.108565/]THIS MOD[/url] here by Breakgate, just throw that mod in, and then replace the sprite with my mod afterwards.
